bib.title: World Model on Million-Length Video and Language with Blockwise RingAttention

question: How can a 7B Llama-2 model be trained to use a 1M-token context over text, images and video, and how well does it retrieve and understand at that length?
hypothesis: Progressively extending context from 32K to 1M with RoPE theta scaling, model-generated QA data and masked sequence packing yields a usable 1M-context text and video-language model without hurting short-context ability.
contributions: Train one of the largest context-size transformers to date on long text and video, with competitive long video understanding and fact retrieval.
Solutions for long-sequence training: masked sequence packing and synthetic model-generated question-answering.
Open-source optimized implementation for million-token training and a family of Llama-based 1M-context models (LWM-Text, LWM-Text-Chat, LWM, LWM-Chat).

method.summary: Two-stage training from Llama-2 7B. Stage I extends text context 32K to 1M in five steps on filtered Books3 with RoPE theta scaled per stage, using Blockwise RingAttention fused with FlashAttention. Stage II adds VQGAN-tokenised images and video (256 tokens per frame), trained progressively 1K to 1M with masked sequence packing.
method.task: long-context language modelling, needle retrieval, long video understanding, image/video generation

datasets.name: Books3 (The Pile), filtered by document length
datasets.preprocessing: filtered by document length per stage

datasets.name: Model-generated QA from Books3
datasets.preprocessing: documents split into 1,000-token chunks; short-context model writes a QA pair per chunk; adjacent chunks concatenated to reach target length with QA pairs appended at end in chat format; < 1% loss tokens per sequence

datasets.name: UltraChat
datasets.preprocessing: pre-packed to the training sequence length, kept separate from QA data

datasets.name: LAION-2B-en + COYO-700M
datasets.source: Schuhmann et al. 2022; Byeon et al. 2022
datasets.preprocessing: images with at least 256 resolution; order of modalities randomly swapped; packed to 1K tokens

datasets.name: WebVid10M + 3M InternVid10M
datasets.source: Bain et al. 2021; Wang et al. 2023
datasets.preprocessing: 30-frame videos at 4FPS; images packed to 8K tokens

datasets.name: ShareGPT4V, Valley-Instruct-73K, Video-ChatGPT-100K
datasets.split: 25% of each chat-stage batch to each of 4 tasks
datasets.preprocessing: video uniformly sampled to a max frame count that fits training context

datasets.name: Needle in a Haystack (magic number / city variant), multi-needle
datasets.preprocessing: N needles inserted, R asked; correctness by string match

datasets.name: VQAv2, GQA, SQA, POPE, MSVD, MSRVTT, TGIF, MT-Bench, lm-eval short tasks

models.name: LWM-Text / LWM-Text-Chat (32K-1M)
models.init_from: LLaMA-2 7B, then each stage from the previous length; chat models from the pretrained text model at same length, no progressive training

models.name: LWM / LWM-Chat
models.architecture: same transformer with VQGAN tokens (aMUSEd, 256x256 -> 16x16 = 256 tokens per frame) and <vision>,</vision>,<eof>,<eov> tokens
models.tokenizer: BPE for text, aMUSEd VQGAN for vision

models.name: GPT-4-1106, Gemini Pro (02/23), GPT-4o, Claude 3 Opus, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, Gemini 1.5 Pro, LLaVA-Video, VideoLLaMA 2, Long-LLaVA, Video-LLaVA

training.objective: next-token prediction over text and vision tokens (image and video generation included); loss re-weighted in packed sequences to match non-packed padded training
training.lr: Stage I text: 4e-5 (all stages); Stage II: max 6e-4 (1K, 8K), 8e-5 (32K, 128K, 1M)
training.lr_schedule: Stage I constant; Stage II cosine (min LR 6e-5 for 1K and 8K, 8e-5 otherwise)
training.batch_size: 4M tokens per batch (text), 8M tokens per batch (vision-language)
training.tokens: Text 4.8B/12B/12B/3B/1.8B; chat 1.2B per stage; Stage II 363B/107B/10B/3.5B/0.4B
training.hardware: TPU v4-512 (text stages), TPU v4-1024 (vision-language), approx 450 A100

other.parallelism: FSDP + Blockwise RingAttention fused with FlashAttention via Pallas
other.Stage II table row labels: Table 8 labels last stages Chat-32K/128K/1M, Table 14 labels them 32K/128K/1M
other.Stage II inits: 1K from Text-1M, then each from the previous
other.MFU: Fig 8 reports high MFU across lengths (values only in figure)

inference.decoding: classifier-free guidance on logits for image/video generation, unconditional branch started with <bos><vision>
inference.prompting: Qualitative video evals at 1FPS, uniformly sampled to max frames, resized and center-cropped to 256x256

other.hardware: 1M-token inference needs minimum v4-128, 32-way tensor parallelism and 4-way sequence (ring) parallelism, single precision, RingAttention for decoding

limits: Vanilla per-frame image tokenizer; no video tokenisation exploiting time redundancy and no continuous (CLIP) embeddings.
Limited scale: only 7B; authors say extrapolation to 100B+ models should be cautious.
Needle tasks test fact retrieval, not synthesis; authors call for harder long-range benchmarks.
Image and short video benchmarks fall below SOTA (Table 5).
Chat mix trades off needle retrieval against chat quality (Table 11).
Optimizer, seeds, repeats and variance are not stated; no ablation of progressive vs direct training or of RoPE theta values.
Comparisons with starred models (Llama-3.1, Qwen2.5, Mistral, Video-MME models) were added after the paper was done, and baselines were run at lengths beyond their trained context.
